summary: Iteration 4 (Direct Convocation) — FULLY VERIFIED backend + frontend. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_convocation.py (6 new tests) and re-ran full suite -> 54/54 pass. Confirmed (a) GET /api/competitions/{id}/availabilities now returns ALL active officials with status='not_requested' for those without a record (verified on a brand-new master-created official 'Sara Neri -> s.neri'); (b) POST /api/competitions/{id}/confirm creates a record with status='convoked', confirmed=True and increments confirmed_count when the target has no prior availability record; (c) removing that purely-convoked official from a subsequent confirm call DELETES the record (row reverts to 'not_requested', confirmed=False, confirmed_count drops); (d) the convoked official immediately sees the competition in GET /api/my/competitions with confirmed=True and status='convoked'; (e) the notification pushed has type='confirmation', title='Sei stato convocato!' and body contains the competition address. Frontend: on the master competition detail Disponibilità tab, all 3 active officials render each with checkbox testID select-<officialId> and correct status badges — verified live 'Disponibile' (m.rossi), 'Non contattato' (g.verdi, l.fusco). The CTA is 'Convoca / Conferma (N)' and reflects the live selection count. Tapping select-<g.verdi-id> then confirm-officials converts g.verdi's badge to 'Convocato' and persists (visible on official g.verdi's home under 'Gare confermate' with 'Confermato' + address, and unread notifications badge 9+). No new backend bugs. Carried-over HIGH bug from iter2 (ensure_reminders_sent latching reminder_sent=True on empty confirmed list) is STILL PRESENT in server.py — unchanged code path — recommend fix in a future iteration.

critical.issue: STILL UNFIXED from iter2/iter3: reminder_sent flag is set to True even when the confirmed list is empty for that competition. Any GET /notifications, /notifications/unread-count, or /competitions call inside the reminder window BEFORE the master confirms any official permanently disables reminders for that competition. Fix: guard reminder_sent=True behind len(confirmed) > 0, or track reminders per availability row.

RN-Web warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. Upstream RN internals; safe to ignore.

action_items: HIGH (still carried over from iter2/iter3): fix ensure_reminders_sent() in /app/backend/server.py — only set reminder_sent=True when at least one reminder was pushed, otherwise the flag latches to empty and confirmations after the reminder window never trigger a reminder.
OPTIONAL cosmetic: migrate shadow*->boxShadow on officials.tsx fab and competitions.tsx segActive.
OPTIONAL cosmetic: disable Modal animation on web to silence useNativeDriver warning.
critical_code_review_comments: competition_availabilities correctly LEFT JOINS active officials with existing availability records and synthesizes status='not_requested' for un-recorded officials — matches new spec.

confirm_officials cleanly handles 3 cases: (1) existing record -> flip confirmed=True and notify with 'Sei stato convocato!' if status not 'available', (2) no record -> insert status='convoked' + notify direct, (3) removed from selection -> delete purely-convoked or unset confirmed for real responders.
competition/[id].tsx renders every row from the API (no client-side filter), uses select-<officialId> testID, correct badge tone map for 'convoked' and 'not_requested' — spec compliant.
Notification title branches ('Sei stato convocato!' vs 'Presenza confermata!') are computed correctly based on whether the official previously declared availability.
Purely-convoked deletion path (delete_one when status=='convoked' and un-selected) prevents the record from lingering as unconfirmed convoked — clean.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login master + open comp + Disponibilità lists all officials with correct badges + select 'Non contattato' official + convoke -> badge flips to Convocato + convoked official sees comp in Gare confermate)
